items.title: MarShawn Lloyd: Limited to 18 total yards in loss
items.body_text: Lloyd rushed four times for 11 yards and brought in two of three targets for seven yards in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Pitts: Limited to one catch in win
items.body_text: Pitts secured one of two targets for five yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tucker Kraft: Modest production with four catches
items.body_text: Kraft secured four of eight targets for 26 yards in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons on Thursday. He also recovered a fumble. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brian Robinson: Gets into end zone in win
items.body_text: Robinson rushed 10 times for 50 yards and a touchdown and returned two kickoffs for 54 yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Penix: Stellar in season debut
items.body_text: Penix completed 18 of 25 passes for 256 yards with one touchdown and one interception while rushing twice for minus-2 yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday. He also threw a two-point conversion pass. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
